items.title: Ray-Ban Meta Audio Drops The Camera For A Lighter, Socially Acceptable Design
items.excerpt: Ray-Ban Meta Audio drops the camera for a lighter and sleeker design that's likely to be more socially acceptable amid the public privacy backlash.
items.rationale: The actual product launch of camera-less Meta AI glasses, after the 09-18 card covered only the report; a real product-design response to the privacy backlash.

items.title: Apple's cheapest iPad is finally getting Apple Intelligence, leaked code shows
items.excerpt: Leaked code indicates Apple's next entry-level iPad will support Apple Intelligence, bringing on-device AI features to its cheapest tablet.
items.rationale: Brings on-device Apple Intelligence to Apple's entry-level tablet, which widens the device base for AI features. No matching card in the history.

items.title: Boston Dynamics' Atlas robot gets new hands
items.excerpt: Boston Dynamics showed redesigned hands for its electric Atlas humanoid, aimed at more dexterous manipulation for real-world tasks.
items.rationale: A new hardware reveal for a leading humanoid robot that adds a robotics angle to a pool heavy on glasses; distinct from the 09-26 Tesla Optimus hands card.

https://www.uploadvr.com/ray-ban-meta-au.new_action: Official launch of the Ray-Ban Meta Audio product (camera-less glasses); the 09-18 card was only a report that Meta was building them.
